001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity;
002
003import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
004import androidx.room.ColumnInfo;
005import androidx.room.Entity;
006import androidx.room.ForeignKey;
007import androidx.room.Index;
008import androidx.room.PrimaryKey;
009
010@Entity(
011    tableName = "track",
012    indices = {
013        @Index({"user_id", "name"})
014    },
015    foreignKeys = {
016        @ForeignKey(entity = User.class, parentColumns = "user_id", childColumns = "user_id", onDelete = ForeignKey.CASCADE)
017    }
018)
019public class Track {
020
021  @PrimaryKey(autoGenerate = true)
022  @ColumnInfo(name = "track_id")
023  private long id;
024
025  @NonNull
026  private String name = "";
027
028  @ColumnInfo(name = "user_id", index = true)
029  private long userId;
030
031  public long getId() {
032    return id;
033  }
034
035  public void setId(long id) {
036    this.id = id;
037  }
038
039  @NonNull
040  public String getName() {
041    return name;
042  }
043
044  public void setName(@NonNull String name) {
045    this.name = name;
046  }
047
048  public long getUserId() {
049    return userId;
050  }
051
052  public void setUserId(long userId) {
053    this.userId = userId;
054  }
055
056}
